title: Military called in as more than 40,000 migrants from Morocco pour into Spanish border territory
llm_summary: Spanish military and police forces were deployed to the North African enclave of Ceuta after tens of thousands of migrants crossed over from Morocco, leaving multiple people dead. Local businesses shuttered amid safety concerns, and the regional government requested an emergency declaration. The influx sparked political controversy both within Spain and across Europe regarding border controls and migration policies.

title: Hundreds of migrants flood into Spain’s Ceuta exclave from Morocco
llm_summary: Spain announced it would deploy armed forces to reinforce security in Ceuta after hundreds of migrants crossed into the North African exclave from Morocco. The influx resulted in the deaths of at least nine migrants and sparked a diplomatic confrontation between Italy and Spain over border controls and the Schengen zone. Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez also faced immediate domestic political pressure from right-wing opposition parties over the border crisis.
